item.title: Evening Weather for Tuesday, August 25
item.description: Good evening! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Tuesday, August 25. Tuesday already. Well done for a good start! Today in Shanghai, it will be drizzly. The warmest part of the day will be 32 degrees, and the coolest 26. Rain is about 16 percent likely today. It's a hot one. A sun hat and a water bottle are a good idea! A good day for a warm drink and a story. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be lovely and sunny, reaching 32 degrees. Here's a question: what would you like to eat for dinner tonight? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
